simplestorage.guide.page.1.title: Simple Storage
simplestorage.guide.page.1: Crates of every wood that hold nine stacks of food in layers, the Storage Crafting Table that keeps its grid on its top, and chests and shulker boxes in three tiers with more slots and bigger stacks.
simplestorage.guide.page.2.title: Crates
simplestorage.guide.page.2: Crates are open wooden boxes shaped like the composter that store up to 9 stacks of food in at most 9 different kinds; each kind is a layer, the newest on top, seen through the slats.
simplestorage.guide.page.3.title: Storage Crafting Table
simplestorage.guide.page.3: The Storage Crafting Table is a crafting table that keeps its 3x3 grid: closing the screen leaves the items where they are, and they lie flat on the table's top.
simplestorage.guide.page.4.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplestorage.guide.page.4: The crates of every wood and the Storage Crafting Table, their block entities, recipes and recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplestorage.guide.page.5.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplestorage.guide.page.5: Old worlds load them under simplestorage:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids; placed crates keep their food and tables their grid.
simplestorage.guide.page.6.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.6: Own tab with the Storage Crafting Table, the crates and the guide.
simplestorage.guide.page.7.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.7: Without SimpleBuilding the table also sits behind the crafting table and the crates behind the barrel in the Vanilla functional blocks tab (switch addItemsToVanillaTabs); with SimpleBuilding its tabs list them in their old places.
simplestorage.guide.page.8.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.8: Switched off (SimpleBuilding's Enable Simple Storage), the tab and the Vanilla tab entries are empty; the blocks keep working.
simplestorage.guide.page.9.title: Chest tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.9: Copper chest -> Reinforced Chest -> Netherite Chest -> Enderite Chest: more slots per tier (27/36/45/54, double chests twice that), and from netherite on bigger stacks per slot (x2, enderite x4).
simplestorage.guide.page.10.title: Chest tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.10: Each step is done in the world with the sledgehammer and keeps everything inside.
simplestorage.guide.page.11.title: Shulker box tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.11: Shulker box -> Reinforced -> Netherite -> Enderite Shulker Box: the slots and stack sizes of the chest tiers (36/45/54 slots, x2 and x4 stacks from netherite on) in a box that keeps everything when broken.
simplestorage.guide.page.12.title: Shulker box tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.12: Upgraded in the world with the sledgehammer like the chests, but dearer: 10 blows and 2 pieces of material per step.

quests.simplestorage.start.welcome.descr: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Storage Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a barrel.
